data.title: Filter paper
data.summary: Office aids · Absorbent paper used for simple bedside tests and for collecting and preserving specimens.
data.body:
Absorbent paper used for simple bedside tests and for collecting and preserving specimens.

## Uses / indications
- Checking dapsone adherence in leprosy - urine drop on filter paper dipped in Ehrlich's reagent
- Sweat tests: ninhydrin (pink) and bromophenol blue (blue) in leprosy and other neuropathies (diabetes, alcohol, HSAN, porphyria)
- Patch testing liquid allergens (formaldehyde, propylene glycol)
- Documenting Auspitz sign
- Collecting and keeping hair, skin scrapings and nail clippings
- Wrapping tattoo pigments for autoclaving
